description: This file defines classes and functions for performing numeric operations on pandas-on-Spark objects, including handling different Spark data types such as float, decimal, and integer types. It includes methods for arithmetic operations, type casting, and special handling for nulls and NaNs.

classes.name: NumericOps
classes.description: Class for binary numeric operations on pandas-on-Spark objects, handling addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and type casting.

classes.name: IntegralOps
classes.description: Class for integer-type binary operations, including bitwise XOR and division.

classes.name: FractionalOps
classes.description: Class for floating-point binary operations, including multiplication, division, and modulo.

classes.name: DecimalOps
classes.description: Class for decimal type operations, with restrictions on comparison operators.

classes.name: IntegralExtensionOps
classes.description: Class for extended integer operations with additional type handling and restore method.

classes.name: FractionalExtensionOps
classes.description: Class for extended floating-point operations with restore and type casting methods.

methods.name: _non_fractional_astype
methods.description: Helper function to cast index operations to a specified dtype and Spark type, handling categorical, boolean, string, and other types.

methods.name: _cast_back_float
methods.description: Cast expression back to original float dtype if needed, ensuring pandas-like behavior in arithmetic operations involving float32.

methods.name: _is_decimal_float_mixed
methods.description: Check if one operand is decimal and the other is float, for special handling in operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Add two pandas-on-Spark objects with type validation and optional ANSI mode float casting.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtract two pandas-on-Spark objects with type validation and optional ANSI mode float casting.

methods.description: Modulo operation with special handling for ANSI mode.

methods.name: rpow
